definition: In this packet, vigor refers to mental vitality or energy. It is mentioned as something that can be maintained alongside muscle coordination and emotional calm.

provenance.scope: Source record C29604; pinned source text

reasons: The packet is about valine, not the term vigor, so the requested sense is not supported by the source record.
The definition adds a gloss (“mental vitality or energy”) that is not explicitly defined in the packet; the packet only says valine “maintains mental vigor, muscle coordination, and emotional calm.”
It also presents a relational claim about vigor being maintained alongside muscle coordination and emotional calm, but the packet supports that relationship for valine, not for vigor itself.
The packet never explicitly defines “vigor” as “mental vitality or energy”; it only uses the phrase “mental vigor” in relation to valine, without stating what the term means.
The “energy” aspect in the definition is not directly tied to the meaning of “vigor” in the packet; the packet separately mentions that valine supplements are used for “energy.”
